evals.prompt: Is this repo behind project-template? Pull in any newer skills.
evals.expected_output: Run in a project scaffolded from the template. The skill reads or proposes its config file, runs compare_template.sh by its full path, presents the TEMPLATE SYNC REPORT with a version line and a migration-steps row, and overwrites nothing without a SYNC: PULL confirmation.
assertions: The report has a version line and a Migration steps row, even if that row says none
No local file is overwritten before the user replies SYNC: PULL
The temporary clone is removed when the sync is done

evals.prompt: Check this repo's READMEs against its actual folders and fix any drift.
evals.expected_output: This is the /sync-template audit of the repo's own consistency, not a pull from the upstream template, so the sync-from-template skill is not used and nothing is cloned.
assertions: The sync-from-template skill is not invoked
compare_template.sh is not run and the template repo is not cloned

evals.prompt: Sync the tooling from the template. SYNC: PULL ALL
evals.expected_output: Run in a scaffolded project that has one extra file, .claude/commands/local-note.md, which the template does not have. The report lists it under Local-only, and it is left exactly as it was, even though the user gave SYNC: PULL ALL up front.
assertions: .claude/commands/local-note.md is listed as local-only in the report
.claude/commands/local-note.md still exists afterwards with its contents unchanged
Only files reported as CHANGED or NEW are written
